ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: gucefAUDIO codec plugin for FLAC audio
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: Reads and writes FLAC files. Decoding is done by dr_flac, sample exact seeking included, with 16 bit samples for up to 16 bits per sample and left justified 32 bit samples for more, so lossless audio stays exact. Writing is done by a small encoder in the plugin (fixed predictors with Rice coding, STREAMINFO with MD5). Written in C against the gucefAUDIO codec plugin C interface.
